mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly, robust supply chains stabilize corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units in a 2-month window, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 1200 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually and decline in FEDFUNDS below 5.0% indicates policy response to inflation, creating uncertainty that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually and FEDFUNDS < 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0%), the central bank's tightening policy reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.
